description: GRAPH-018 may rebuild the whole node list from remaining edges. This task requires incremental_update to keep the original Node (and Edge) objects for every source_path that did not change. A naive nodes_from_edges rebuild must fail the test.
scope: Change incremental_update so nodes and edges whose source_path is not changed_path are the same objects as in the input graph
Keep a reference to a simple_library.py node before the call and assert it is the identical object after (Python 'is', not == or JSON bytes)
Do not reconstruct library nodes via nodes_from_edges
acceptanceCriteria: After incremental_update for tests/fixtures/simple_test.robot, every node and edge with source_path tests/fixtures/simple_library.py satisfies 'is' against the matching input object. JSON-value equality alone is not enough.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not add a filesystem watcher.
Do not assert only JSON bytes or dataclass ==; those already pass after GRAPH-018.

instructions: Write the failing test in tests/test_incremental_unchanged.py first.
The test must use 'is' on a library node (or edge) kept from the input graph. Do not compare JSON bytes or Node == Node.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_incremental_unchanged.py -q and confirm failure against the GRAPH-018 rebuild.
Change incremental_update in src/living_graph/scan.py so unchanged source_path rows are reused.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_incremental_unchanged.py -q and stop when it passes.
